verdict.rationale: ReadMe's Analytics has a dedicated MCP page that records every call AI clients make to the project's MCP server, including tools called, latency, failures and queries. This sits alongside separate docs and API metrics for human usage, so agent traffic via MCP is isolated from human docs analytics. However, nothing shows that regular docs page views are classified as AI crawler/agent versus human visitors. Missing for 10: agent-vs-human classification of web docs page traffic (e.g. LLM crawlers, llms.txt/.md fetches), a unified comparative view of agent and human readership, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
